headline: New era in title deed transactions: starts October 1
summary: A secure payment system that synchronises money transfers with title deed transfers in real estate sales is expected to become mandatory on 1 October. It aims to protect buyers and sellers from fraud.
why: Changes to property payment rules affect transaction costs and risk in Turkey's real estate market.
